summary: Public projects created on 18 July 2026: 6 repos.
intro: Printable reference material dominates: wall posters covering the Eurobox container system and the eleven Incoterms 2020 rules, plus an index of the print-ready set. The remaining repositories hold a Linux microphone fix for laptop voice recognition, a recency-grouped directory listing tool, and a placeholder for Home Assistant blueprints.

projects.name: Dictamic
projects.description: Fix laptop internal-mic voice recognition accuracy on Linux: PipeWire WebRTC AGC pipeline + monitor GUI (.deb)

projects.name: Eurobox Poster
projects.description: Printable wall poster of the Eurobox / Euro-container system: 600x400 module, footprints, standard heights, pallet and TEU loads. Print-ready PDFs in three sizes.

projects.name: HA Blueprints
projects.description: Placeholder repo for Home Assistant blueprints I use (mostly by other authors)

projects.name: Incoterms Poster
projects.description: A printable wall poster of the 11 Incoterms® 2020 rules, organized into three responsibility groups (buyer bears most, shared, seller bears most), with a journey diagram showing where risk passes...

projects.name: Lsrecent
projects.description: Directory listing grouped by recency (today / week / month / quarter / older) with a per-directory ls override mechanism

projects.name: Printables Index
projects.description: Index of my printable reference posters — print-ready wall posters built from HTML/CSS and rendered with Vivliostyle
